name: logging_collector
description: Enables a dedicated subprocess to capture stderr output and CSV logs into rotating log files on disk.
symptoms: Log message loss under high load
Inability to persist logs across restarts
Unstructured or missing log history for troubleshooting
stderr logs flooding system console or journal
tuning_tips: Enable it in production for reliable, file-based logging; disable only in minimal development environments where log persistence is unnecessary. Requires server restart to change.
